title: image
description: Locate the element visually by template image (OpenCV template matching, auto-scaled across display scales). Combinable with other element criteria.
$comment: Keep tiny: this whole document inlines ~15,000x when dereferenced (ADR 01087). Region shape validates at runtime.

anyOf.title: Image (simple)
anyOf.description: Template image: a PNG/JPEG file path (resolved relative to the spec) or a data:image/…;base64 URI.

path.description: Template image: a PNG/JPEG file path (resolved relative to the spec) or a data:image/…;base64 URI.

matchThreshold.description: Minimum normalized match score (0–1). Defaults to the config-level `imageMatching.matchThreshold` (0.8).

region.description: Search area: a rect ({x, y, width, height} in logical units) or element criteria (selector, elementText, …) whose match's bounds become the search area. Shape is validated at runtime; a nested `image` is rejected.
